translations.web: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
translations.bsb: So Barnabas and Saul, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
translations.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
